title: One ChatPanel shared by ChatEmbed and ChatSection
evidence: Auto-scroll shared via hooks/useFollowLatest.ts (US-15 AC55, PR 870). Message list and composer now one copy in components/ChatPanel.tsx (ChatMessageList, ChatComposer), drawn by both; differences are named props. Pure move: pins' .snap unchanged, all built CSS byte-identical. Left by design: History (drawer vs in-place list), frame (region vs dialog), lazy load. The two open questions are settled (US-15 AC77, Brad 26 Nov): the panel takes the pop-up's words from one table (components/chat-copy.ts chatCopy), and a panel shown counts as chat_panel_shown beside the pop-up's chat_opened
